notes: Geese chasing ducks and turning the tagged into geese is infection tag, which Party & Casual recognises directly; the lobby obby is a real second thing the author asked for, so Obby & Platformer is named as secondary and lends path-track for the course. Childhood Game with its shape kept, but obstacle-maze dropped because a bright open park with simple paths is the opposite of a hiding warren, leaving cover-los for the trees and run-around clutter and social-hub for the lobby. Without a user I decided the lobby sits inside the same continuous park rather than behind a separated stage, since the genre note says tag never needs the isolated stage and forcing it would buy P4 for nothing; the P6 here comes from the obby's platform track, not from a genre-wide obby route, since obby is not leading. The round timer and the avatar cosmetics you win are gameplay and inventory rather than geometry, so nothing was emitted for them.
